# GTM Anatomy

> GTM Anatomy builds AI Operating Systems for go-to-market teams at start-ups and
> scale-ups, tuned to each business, its brand, and its goals. We align teams on
> their go-to-market foundations, encode them into AI infrastructure the team owns,
> and keep that system learning as the brand evolves.

Category: AI infrastructure for go-to-market teams.
Tagline: Your brand. Your context. Your AI.
Pricing is published: Anatomy Scan $5,000, typically delivered within two weeks.
Anatomy OS $25,000, typically within three to six weeks. AI Sprint from $5,000,
timeline scoped per project. Fractional Partner $8,500 per month, covering
marketing, go-to-market, and GTM engineering. The Anatomy Scan fee credits into an Anatomy OS build.
Ideal customer: B2B technology start-ups and scale-ups, Series A through Series C,
with go-to-market teams of 1 to 100 expected to produce like a much larger one.
The company can be far bigger; the GTM team is what we size to.
Founded by Rachel W Bruce, who has spent more than fifteen years building and
leading marketing organizations in cybersecurity, AI, robotics, FinTech, and
technology distribution, at Continuous, Plus One Robotics, Moogsoft (acquired by
Dell), Very Good Security, and Trustwave.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://gtmanatomy.ai/index.md): what GTM Anatomy is, the four offerings, and what the work means by role.
- [About](https://gtmanatomy.ai/about.md): why the practice exists, how we work, who it is for, and the founder's background.
- [Contact](https://gtmanatomy.ai/contact.md): book a strategy call or send a note.

## Offerings

- [Offerings overview](https://gtmanatomy.ai/offerings/index.md): the four offerings in sequence and what every engagement includes.
- [Anatomy Scan](https://gtmanatomy.ai/offerings/anatomy-scan.md): a two-week diagnostic of your go-to-market foundations and AI readiness, ending in a 90-day roadmap. $5,000, typically delivered within two weeks.
- [Anatomy OS](https://gtmanatomy.ai/offerings/anatomy-os.md): the full build of an AI-native go-to-market operating system for your team. $25,000, typically delivered within three to six weeks.
- [AI Sprint](https://gtmanatomy.ai/offerings/ai-sprint.md): scoped project work against your roadmap. Starting at $5,000, timeline scoped per project.
- [Fractional Partner](https://gtmanatomy.ai/offerings/fractional-partner.md): a standing seat in marketing, go-to-market, or GTM engineering, or across all three. $8,500 per month, with hourly rates for project work.
